description:
Lot of 5 Vintage Glass Electrical Insulators Hemingray Blue Green Clear
This lot includes 5 vintage glass electrical insulators featuring both aqua/blue-green and clear glass varieties. Two blue-green insulators are marked with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. Each insulator is made of heavy, thick glass with a classic double-groove design. Most pieces exhibit signs of age including minor dirt, residue, and surface wear but have no major cracks or chips visible. The clear glass insulators include one with a partial label and some with embossed markings. These insulators were originally used on telegraph and power lines and are suitable for collectors or as decorative industrial items.
9 x 8 x 4 in

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production

description:
A single bookend cut from a half agate geode from Brazil, with a polished face showing white and gray quartz crystal banded by tan and rust colored agate. The rough natural rind is left on the curved outer edge, and the flat cut side stands upright without a base. A small oval foil label reading semi precious stones made in Brazil and a handwritten paper tag are affixed to one side, and a teal felt pad is attached to the bottom. Sold as a single piece, not a pair.

Condition: Natural pits, chips and mineral roughness along the uncut rind. The felt bottom pad is worn and soiled, and the paper label is aged with a torn corner.

description: This lot includes 12 vintage glass telephone pole insulators primarily manufactured by Hemingray and Whitall Tatum. The insulators are made of clear, aqua, and light green glass and feature embossed branding and model numbers, including Hemingray-42 and Whitall Tatum No. 1. The condition varies among pieces, with some showing visible chips, cracks, and signs of wear consistent with age and use. These insulators are historically significant for telegraph and power line applications and are commonly collected or used as decorative items. Overall, the set is used with minor to moderate damage on certain pieces. Approximately 3.75" D, 4" H each.

description:
German Hunter Style Tobacco Pipe
Munchen Edition, Modular Construction
Wood, Metal, and Horn, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A classic German "Jager" or hunter-style tobacco pipe, featuring the traditional modular multi-piece construction characteristic of Central European alpine regions. This specific piece is detailed with "Munchen" (Munich) engraved on the bowl, identifying it as a regional piece from the Bavarian capital. Designed for functionality in outdoor settings, these pipes feature long stems to cool the smoke and wind caps to protect the embers.
Modular design consisting of a polished wood bowl, bark-covered wooden stem section, and horn mouthpiece transition
Decorative hinged metal wind cap with ornate perforations and a secure latch mechanism
